Decisions: D1 GUI Production confirmation uses the core guard; D2 other GUI/TUI differences are kept behind named options; D5 no TLS one-click for Production (core refuses too); D7 bundle.macOS.minimumSystemVersion = 13.0. The App.tsx / TUI app.rs splits happen in the NEXT run: write new UI in the current files (App.tsx, components, crates/tui/src/app.rs) in small self-contained functions/components so the later move is easy. sharedDbs: PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector at 127.0.0.1:55433 (user postgres, trust auth; QURRY_TEST_PG=127.0.0.1:55433:postgres:postgres), MySQL 8.4 at 127.0.0.1:13306 (root / dbtool, database shop; QURRY_TEST_MY=127.0.0.1:13306:root:dbtool:shop), Redis 7 at 127.0.0.1:16379 (QURRY_TEST_REDIS=127.0.0.1:16379; tests that FLUSHDB must use a db number no other item uses). A mysql client is available by running the mysql:8.4 image as a --rm container named qurry-demo-<x>. Extra servers (e.g. MySQL 5.7, MariaDB) may be started only as qurry-demo-<x> on free ports and must be removed when done. Do not leave dev servers (vite, storybook, preview) or containers running when you finish.

items.breaks: Nobody; a new tunnel option. Users need AWS CLI v2 and the Session Manager plugin (brew install --cask session-manager-plugin) only if they use it.
items.task:
Add AWS SSM Session Manager as a third tunnel option next to SSH (data source form: None / SSH / AWS SSM). Fields: AWS profile, region, target instance id (plus the remote host/port = the data source host/port). Core: spawn `aws ssm start-session --target --document-name AWS-StartPortForwardingSessionToRemoteHost --parameters host=,portNumber=,localPortNumber= [--profile] [--region]` via tokio::process with kill_on_drop, wait until the local port accepts (with a timeout), connect through 127.0.0.1:, kill on drop (same lifecycle as the SSH Tunnel struct). Qurry stores no AWS secrets: it uses the user's AWS config/SSO. Clear messages: aws CLI not found (install link), session-manager-plugin missing, SSO token expired ('Run: aws sso login --profile

'), access denied / target not connected; never echo env or credentials. Validate profile/region/instance id characters before passing them (no shell; args as a vector). Works in GUI (form tab with test), TUI (form fields) and MCP (through core). store.rs: serde-default fields so old connections.json load and older apps keep working; same_ssh/password-reuse rules treat the SSM target as part of the server identity. Storybook first: the SSM tab in the ConnectionDialog stories; TUI form snapshot scene. Docs en+ko (data-sources). Tests first with a fake `aws` script on PATH (scratch dir) that prints the real CLI's messages and listens on the port: success, CLI missing, plugin missing, SSO expired, process exits early, timeout; the process is gone after drop. Real AWS verification is done by the user later: say so in the report.
